_readme: Two-man booth calling ONE slap, end to end — the reference performance for tools/voice.py. Marks match the standard scripted swing used by promo.js (S held from 2.6s, contact 4.083s). Render on the Mac: python3 tools/voice.py render tools/vo-booth-demo.json --mix ; set "bed" to a rendered score.wav to hear it ducked under music.
name: booth-demo

lines.text: HE [emph]SLAPPED[/emph] HIM! [beat 200] HE SLAPPED HIM CLEAN!
That volunteer is [rise]up, up, UP[/rise] — [riff gooone]
Forty years of fairs, Howie. [beat 400] Never seen a man volunteer that hard.
Watch the hips. [beat 300] The hips knew [emph]first[/emph].
The county reminds you: volunteering is [emph]binding[/emph].
